figures.original_caption_text: Figure 6: SONIC enables universal humanoid motion tracking through a universal control policy that handles diverse motion commands and modalities. Specialized encoders process robot, human, and hybrid motion commands into a universal token that drives robot control and motion decoders. This multi-encoder design supports diverse applications including gamepad control, VR teleoperation, whole-body teleoperation, and video teleoperation.
